ns2:section.sectionText: Course is ALWAYS restricted to Economics Majors. This course will have 4 REQUIRED in-class meetings: CLASS 1 (Initial Kick-off Meeting): August 29 or September 6; CLASS 2 (Resumes): September 11 or September 12; CLASS 3 (Professionalism/Networking): October 9 or October 10; CLASS 4 (Interviewing): November 6 or November 7. All Class Meetings are 4:00pm-4:50pm in 114 David Kinley Hall (DKH). Students will be provided additional information via email, and will confirm in advance which course meeting they will attend. Additional work will be completed outside the class time both online, and by attending additional on-campus events/workshops (information provided in the first class session).
